arguments.body: Dear Ms Fletcher, I'm sorry about the trouble with your front door. We've treated it as urgent and asked your landlord today to let us send a contractor to inspect it now. We can't promise a date until they reply, and nothing is booked yet. Until then, please close the door gently rather than slamming it, as slamming could crack the glass. Could you tell us two things: can you always get out of and back into the flat, and does the door lock securely when closed? If you ever can't get out, or feel unsafe, call 999. We'll update you by Monday 10 June. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings
